data.body: **[P2] Delay terminal hooks until SDK-controlled delivery completes.** `ExecutionManager.close()`, response-envelope serialization, and `outputStream.write()` still occur after plugins observe `SUCCEEDED` (and likewise `FAILED`). If one fails, Lambda retries after OTel has exported a terminal Workflow span and other plugins may have committed terminal side effects. Extend the worker-owned finalization boundary through manager shutdown and response emission, report `RETRYING` on failure, and add a failing-output-stream regression test.
